key_effect_directions.claim: On the primary pair, C3 with 1,024 random anchors will exceed C2 Recall@5 in both directions at both seeds.
On the primary pair, C3 Q1 Recall@5 averaged across directions and seeds will increase from 64 to 1,024 random anchors.
Scrambled-anchor C3 Recall@5 will exceed the C2 floor by more than 0.05 in at least one tested configuration, violating that control.

forecast.rationale: The reported paired-anchor retrieval strength makes KILL unlikely and supports substantial C3 improvement over naive translation, but does not establish zero-fit retention or provenance at the frozen thresholds. The conjunction across directions and seeds leaves substantial failure risk, especially for provenance. Shared random-word anchors can retain cross-model lexical structure, making the required scrambled-anchor collapse particularly doubtful. SPLIT has zero probability because the protocol explicitly classifies partial gate success as FAIL.
